 Good morning! Here's the latest in trending: 

 Anthropic debut: 'Dark period for tech' and massive founder wealth .

 NYC delivery bill: Amazon ( AMZN ) appeals directly to shoppers .

 AI selloff: Taiwan's benchmark index posts worst week since 1991.


 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Top News
 
 
 
 Listing victory 
 
 
 
Getty Images
 
 
 The trajectory for the Anthropic ( ANT ) IPO is still up for discussion , but there is one clear winner that has been above the debate. The Nasdaq ( NDAQ ) has walked away from the notable debut with a swagger after snatching the biggest listing of all time. Less than six months ago, the stock exchange scored another record IPO, wooing SpaceX ( SPCX ) to its market.

 Bigger picture: It's been a bumper year for the Nasdaq, which has outpaced its main rival by a 10x spread. According to Dealogic, there have been 64 Nasdaq IPOs this year that have raised $201.8B, compared to the $20.8B total raised from 42 IPOs on the New York Stock Exchange. Shareholders have been happy with the performance, with Nasdaq shares climbing 21% over the past year, and 92% over the last three years, nearly double the returns of NYSE-parent Intercontinental Exchange ( ICE ).

"Anthropic's IPO is a very proud moment for us," Nasdaq CEO Adena Friedman told Reuters. "We've been engaging with the Anthropic team for a very long time. Separate from the entire listing experience, we've been a client to them, as we are to the AI ecosystem, and so we also have gotten to know them in that context as well."

 What's the difference? Besides the emphasis on courtship, especially to Silicon Valley and high-growth disruptors, the Nasdaq's ( NDAQ ) ecosystem provides some structural advantages. Those include significantly lower listing fees, more flexible entry requirements, and generally faster IPO processing. A Nasdaq listing also offers access to popular benchmarks like the Nasdaq-100 ( NDX ), and the exchange has even loosened its rules to fast-track names like SpaceX to boost liquidity and broaden the overall shareholder base.
